name: list_notes
summary: List notes from Notes.app, most recently modified first. Returns each note's id — pass that id to read_note or append_to_note. Optionally restrict to one folder. Drives Notes via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Notes.

params.name: folder
params.description: Restrict to a single folder by exact name (see list_folders). Omit to list across all folders.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: search_notes
summary: Search notes in Notes.app whose title or body contains a term (case-insensitive), most recently modified first. Returns each match's id. Drives Notes via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Notes.

params.name: query
params.description: Text to search for within a note's title or body (case-insensitive substring).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: read_note
summary: Read a single note's full plain-text contents, identified by its id (from list_notes/search_notes). A locked (password-protected) note returns a placeholder rather than its contents. Drives Notes via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Notes.

params.name: id
params.description: The note's id, as returned by list_notes or search_notes.

name: list_folders
summary: List the note folders in Notes.app by name, so a valid folder can be chosen for create_note. Drives Notes via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Notes.

name: create_note
summary: Create a note in Notes.app with a title and optional body, in a named folder or the default folder. STAGED for confirmation; undo deletes the created note (matched by its title).

params.name: title
params.description: The note's title (becomes the first, bold line of the note).

params.name: body
params.description: Optional note body text. Newlines are preserved as line breaks.

params.name: folder
params.description: Exact name of the folder to create the note in (see list_folders). Omit to use the default folder.

name: append_to_note
summary: Append text to an existing note in Notes.app, identified by its id (from list_notes/search_notes). STAGED for confirmation; undo restores the note's previous contents. A locked note cannot be appended to.

params.name: id
params.description: The note's id, as returned by list_notes or search_notes.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to append to the note as a new block. Newlines are preserved as line breaks.
